subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “Some plastic cannot be recycled by the center at all.”?
options: Other students can take it home and keep it.
Then students began thanking cleaners, guards, kitchen workers, and bus drivers.
Students brought batteries from remote controls, toys, and clocks at home.
On the bus home, the students were quieter than usual.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「Other students can take it home and keep it.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Then students began thanking cleaners, guards, kitchen workers, and bus drivers.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Students brought batteries from remote controls, toys, and clocks at home.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「Some plastic cannot be recycled by the center at all. On the bus home, the students were quieter than usual.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「Some plastic cannot be recycled by the center at all. On the bus home, the students were quieter than usual.」，答案為「On the bus home, the students were quieter than usual.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「On the bus home, the students were quieter than usual.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
